name: Derecske (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Derecske (a blue shield with a white charge, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name DERECSKE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Derecske arms with helm, crest and mantling
